items.source:
Usage: Specify "targetClass"/"targetMethod" or "targetObject"/"targetMethod",
optionally specify arguments, prepare the invoker. Afterwards, you may
invoke the method any number of times, obtaining the invocation result.
items.translation: 用法：指定 "targetClass"/"targetMethod" 或 "targetObject"/"targetMethod"，可选地指定参数，准备调用器。之后，您可以多次调用该方法并获取调用结果。

items.source: Can for example be used to determine the return type.
items.translation: 例如，它可以用来确定返回类型。

items.source: The invoker needs to have been prepared before.
items.translation: 调用者必须在此之前已做好准备。

items.source:
Determines a weight that represents the class hierarchy difference between types and
arguments. A direct match, i.e. type Integer → arg of class Integer, does not increase
the result - all direct matches means weight 0. A match between type Object and arg of
class Integer would increase the weight by 2, due to the superclass 2 steps up in the
hierarchy (i.e. Object) being the last one that still matches the required type Object.
Type Number and class Integer would increase the weight by 1 accordingly, due to the
superclass 1 step up the hierarchy (i.e. Number) still matching the required type Number.
Therefore, with an arg of type Integer, a constructor (Integer) would be preferred to a
constructor (Number) which would in turn be preferred to a constructor (Object).
All argument weights get accumulated.
items.translation: 确定一个权重，以表示类型和参数之间的类层次结构差异。直接匹配（即类型为 Integer → 参数为 Integer 类）不会增加结果——所有直接匹配的权重均为 0。类型为 Object 与参数为 Integer 类的匹配会使权重增加 2，因为层次结构中向上 2 步的父类（即 Object）是最后一个仍匹配所需类型 Object 的类。类型为 Number 与类 Integer 的匹配会相应地使权重增加 1，因为层次结构中向上 1 步的父类（即 Number）仍匹配所需的类型 Number。因此，对于类型为 Integer 的参数，构造函数 (Integer) 将优先于构造函数 (Number)，而后者又将优先于构造函数 (Object)。所有参数权重均累加。

items.source:
Note: This is the algorithm used by MethodInvoker itself and also the algorithm
used for constructor and factory method selection in Spring's bean container (in case
of lenient constructor resolution which is the default for regular bean definitions).
items.translation: 注：这是 `MethodInvoker` 本身使用的算法，也是 Spring 的 Bean 容器用于构造函数和工厂方法选择的算法（在宽松构造函数解析的情况下，这是常规 Bean 定义的默认行为）。

items.translation: 返回方法调用的参数。

items.source:
Set the target class on which to call the target method.
Only necessary when the target method is static; else,
a target object needs to be specified anyway.
items.translation:
设置要调用目标方法的目标类。
仅当目标方法是静态方法时才需要；否则，无论如何都需要指定目标对象。

设置要调用目标方法的目标对象。
仅当目标方法不是静态方法时才需要；否则，一个目标类就足够了。

items.source:
Set the name of the method to be invoked.
Refers to either a static method or a non-static method,
depending on a target object being set.
items.translation:
设置要调用的方法名称。
根据是否设置了目标对象，该方法指代静态方法或非静态方法。

items.source:
Set a fully qualified static method name to invoke,
for example, "example.MyExampleClass.myExampleMethod". This is a
convenient alternative to specifying targetClass and targetMethod.
items.translation: 设置要调用的完全限定静态方法名，例如"example.MyExampleClass.myExampleMethod"。这是指定 targetClass 和 targetMethod 的便捷替代方案。

items.source:
Set arguments for the method invocation. If this property is not set,
or the Object array is of length 0, a method with no arguments is assumed.
items.translation: 设置方法调用的参数。如果未设置此属性，或 Object 数组长度为 0，则假定该方法无参数。

items.source:
Prepare the specified method.
The method can be invoked any number of times afterwards.
items.translation:
准备指定的方法。
此后可以多次调用该方法。

and a specific list of arguments that this method is supposed to be invoked with.
items.translation: 用于判断候选方法的声明参数类型与该方法预期调用时的特定参数列表之间匹配情况的算法。
